insights.one_liner: Research university in Nijmegen and an IND recognised sponsor; its open jobs here are all research posts, none requiring Dutch.

culture.text: A Dutch research university in Nijmegen; all 7 open jobs here are in research and academia.
71% of its postings show the salary, which helps when comparing PhD or research offers.

open.text: Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
All 7 of its jobs here are open to non-Dutch speakers; LinkedIn postings drew about 31 applicants on average.

worth_knowing.text: The university barred a nationalist student group after a warning from the Dutch intelligence service.
Publisher Sage retracted eight papers by a dismissed former Radboud researcher over a compromised peer-review process.
